description: Takes no arguments and returns the business's website (SEO) page inventory, most recently updated first: count, truncated, and items, with at most 500 items. Each item has id, siteId, slug, title, h1, metaDescription, cluster, city, state, status, and updatedAt. It returns metadata only; page body text is not returned. This Neuron Expert MCP server tool is read-only and reads only the one business whose owner approved the connection and granted read:website on the consent screen. Results are JSON objects also returned as text; the limit is 60 requests per minute per connection, and a refused read returns a tool error with a short reason text.
name: neuron_site_pages

truncated.description: True when the read stopped at its row cap (500; contact search 25).

title: List site pages
